findings.what_happened: The agent formulated the search query using conversational and closed-ended questions as well as complex Boolean logic (`AND`) and quotation marks, violating guidelines 3 and 4.
findings.quote: "Who are the members of the band Blue Sky Riders?" AND "Georgia Middleman began singing career age ten San Antonio" AND "Is San Antonio the seventh most populated city in the US?"

findings.what_happened: The agent used quotation marks in the query, violating guideline 6 which explicitly instructs not to use quotation marks, Boolean operators, or advanced search syntax.
findings.quote: "Who is the member of the group formed by Kenny Loggins who started singing at age ten in San Antonio, and is San Antonio the seventh-most populated city in the US?"
